events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up @ Sephora Meatpacking
events.what_it_is: Yepoda K-beauty pop-up outside Sephora Meatpacking with product trials, giveaways and Sephora gift-card/full-size-product prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Attendance is free with no purchase necessary; exclusive free gifts are available while supplies last. Gift-with-purchase offers require qualifying Sephora purchases.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Separate gift-with-purchase offers require a $40+ or $60+ Sephora purchase. Eventbrite currently advertises free tickets; no host-approval step is established.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 12–6 PM, on 13th Street in front of Sephora Meatpacking. No purchase necessary to attend and receive the advertised general freebies.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum × Macy’s Sampling
events.address: Macy’s Herald Square Plaza, 151 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: Outdoor sampling pop-up celebrating Max Mara Le Parfum at Macy’s Herald Square Plaza.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and chances at special giveaways, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Samples, gelato and giveaways are while supplies last. Current listings describe the plaza activation as free and do not establish an advance RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy’s Herald Square Plaza. A Patch calendar header shows 9 AM, but its event body and City Guide both specify 10 AM–6 PM; the corroborated body time is used here.

events.event_name: AC/DC PWR/UP Pop Up — New York
events.address: Hard Rock Cafe Times Square, 1501 Broadway, New York, NY 10036
events.what_it_is: Official AC/DC tour pop-up with exclusive New York merchandise, tour props and displays, photo opportunities and on-site giveaways.
events.what_is_free: General public entry, photo/prop experience and eligibility for advertised on-site giveaways; merchandise and food/drink are sold separately.
events.caveats: General public event is free and no concert ticket is required. Some promotional pages also describe an early-entry preview selection program; that should not be confused with ordinary public admission.
events.practical_notes: Public dates are Sept. 24–25 at Hard Rock Cafe Times Square. Current event listings specify Sept. 24 11 AM–9 PM and Sept. 25 11 AM–6 PM. A separate Sept. 23 preview night is advertised as open to all by a current event listing, but it is omitted here pending stronger first-party confirmation of that added date.
